title: 3. Why does excessive agency happen?
summary: Common causes: 1. Giving an agent access to every available tool. 2. Using administrator credentials for ordinary operations. 3. Allowing unlimited autonomous execution. 4. Failing to limit the number of tool calls. 5. Not requiring human approval for high-impact actions. 6. Allowing one agent to control another agent…
objectives: Explain every point in “3. Why does excessive agency happen?” with clear language
Use the flow diagram to see what happens one step after another
Connect the visual flow to the written explanation and code

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Common causes:

1. Giving an agent access to every available tool.
2. Using administrator credentials for ordinary operations.
3. Allowing unlimited autonomous execution.
4. Failing to limit the number of tool calls.
5. Not requiring human approval for high-impact actions.
6. Allowing one agent to control another agent without restrictions.
